resources.string: The project plays at %1$d fps, so frames above that rate are not shown. Raise the project\'s frame rate in the project settings.
Frames are made by following how things move between two source frames. Slow the clip down to see it.
Makes smooth in-between frames when the clip is slowed down, by following how things move.
Speed is how many times the blur is applied: more times, more obvious streaks.
Streaks moving things along their path, using the same flow between frames. It works on this clip only.
Move the playhead onto the clip to place a keyframe.
